objective: Initialize AgentBrowser design governance and a discussion plan for a mobile-first detachable browser backed by the authorized Obscura fork.

boundary.payload_control_separation: Host session, attachment and viewport control remain typed control resources, separate from webpage payloads.

acceptance_criteria: AppSDK initializes and its actual validation result is recorded
Design separates confirmed requirements from proposals and open decisions
Plan identifies cross-repository owners and real Mac/Android acceptance
non_goals: Claiming runtime acceptance from design checks
assumptions: User request authorizes new AgentBrowser governance and design files; remote repository has no initial commit
